apps.name: Dispatcher
apps.description: Schedule outbound pickups and inbound arrivals, track load progress, and view daily timelines.
apps.releaseNotes:
Dispatcher 1.1.0

Pair your phone with desktop MES and manage more of the shipping workflow from Dispatcher.

- Scan the MES pairing QR code from Config and see your paired station.
- Use Start Loading to select an available dock, review the trailer number and optional seal, and update the load to Loading.
- Print Picking Lists, Shipping Labels, and Bills of Lading through Android's native print dialog.
- Picking selections include the summary and each DC's complete breakdown, including overflow pages. Completed DC options are disabled.
- PDF downloads show percentage progress, support Cancel and Retry, and use WebRTC when available with automatic socket fallback.
- Shipping labels are marked Printed only after Android reports successful print-job completion.
- Choose Inbounds, Outbounds, or both for Today. The vertical timeline positions NOW proportionally between appointment times.
- Hourly scheduling buttons show box-volume bars, with a configurable maximum of 700 boxes per hour by default.
- Pull down to reveal search, pull farther to refresh, and pan up to hide search again.
- Refined inbound cards, inspection indicators, selection dialogs, and bottom navigation animations.

Android 9 or newer. Pairing, Start Loading, and printing require the updated MES server; PDF preparation requires the updated paired desktop MES. WebRTC also requires the latest desktop transfer implementation. Android printer availability depends on installed print services.

Install over the production Dispatcher app to retain its settings. The earlier review app is a separate installation. MES authorization is required; saved sessions may expire. Status notices require an active connection.

apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Your MES apps and updates, together in one place.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.10

Distinct Featured cards for your workplace apps:
- Dispatcher has a charcoal-and-amber pickup timeline and truck illustration.
- Time Punch has a sage-and-green clock and employee punch illustration.
- SignPad keeps its signature artwork with updated messaging.
- MES Store is excluded from Featured and remains available under Apps.

- Dispatcher displays its actual launcher icon throughout the store, including before installation.
- The bottom navigation is more compact, leaving more room for app content.
- Download and installation buttons fill as progress bars and show measured percentages.
- Installation still requires Android confirmation, with cancellation, retry, and interrupted-session recovery.

Install over the existing MES Store to preserve settings and downloads. Android 9 or newer. The package ID and release signing key are unchanged.
